title: Line sketch: Moonlit House in Foggy Hills
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A solitary silhouetted building perches on rolling hills beneath a pale moon, shrouded in dense atmospheric fog. Tall foreground grass leads the eye through layered misty fields toward the distant structure. Soft gradients and muted tones create depth with strong atmospheric perspective (derived from painting #49).
